# Axomiya IT Labs

> Rooted in Assam and open to everyone: learn AI and open source by building practical tools from local ideas, and help make technology accessible for all.

Axomiya IT Labs is a bilingual AI and open-source community. The site shares learning resources, projects, research, announcements, and ways to contribute. English pages are available at the root; Assamese pages use the `/as/` prefix. Some Assamese content entries are translation placeholders; those pages link to their English versions.
